'''Mr. Electric''' (Japanese: '''ミスターエレク''' ''Mr. Elec'') is a minor recurring character in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. He is a member of the [[Revengers]].

==History==
Mr. Electric debuted in ''[[SM081|A Young Royal Flame Ignites!]]'', where he battled the {{an|Professor Kukui|Masked Royal}} and his {{TP|Professor Kukui|Incineroar}} with his {{p|Electivire}}. During the battle, Mr. Electric grabbed a hold of Incineroar's leg to prevent it from moving whilst Electivire prepared to attack. Despite Mr. Electric's interference, Incineroar was able to attack Electivire, only for [[Mad Magmar]] and his {{p|Magmortar}} to interfere, resulting in them being disqualified. The next day, Mr. Electric teamed up with Mad Magmar in a [[Battle Royal]] tag battle. They went up against Masked Royal and {{Ash}} and battled Incineroar and {{AP|Torracat}}, only to be defeated.

Mr. Electric reappeared in ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', where he was among the 151 Trainers taking part in the [[Battle Royal]] preliminary round of the [[Manalo Conference]]. He teamed up with Mad Magmar and battled {{an|Kiawe}} and his {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}} with Electivire, only to be defeated.

==Character==
Mr. Electric is a menacing man who likes to follow the [[Revengers]]' playbook, resorting to relentless attacks and cheating in order to win at the [[Battle Royal Dome]].
